what_changed: The clock face now carries a real Penrose staircase (Escher's Ascending and Descending): a 22-step spiral that rises five treads a lap and only closes from one viewpoint. Its geometry is computed exactly, then redrawn by the image model as carved stone in the shot's coloured-pencil-and-engraving hand (checked tread by tread). Fifteen ink-engraved agents walk it one step per beat, all clockwise, which I measured on the rendered frames by tracking three agents over four beats. The clunk on the beat is a flash, shake and punch-in.
